## Before opening

- Search existing issues and the [documentation](https://github.com/FutureWindAI/Wotchi/blob/main/docs/README.md).
- For a suspected vulnerability, do not open a public issue; follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/FutureWindAI/Wotchi/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
- Remove tokens, private keys, production URLs, customer data, and proprietary source.
